title: BOMB (1998 version)
description: The official homepage of BOMB, a French demoscene group: news, member memories, incoming projects, demo downloads, pixel art, links and credits, behind a popup-style entry page.
changes: Modernised to run today: intro in an iframe instead of a popup, old document.layers scripts rewritten, Java applets run with CheerpJ, SSI include inlined.

title: Made (1999 version)
description: A personal graphics site from 1999: digital art, a gallery of pictures in period formats with downloadable packs, news, an about page and links.
changes: Tweaked to run today: site shown in an iframe instead of a popup, entry page split from the framed page, missing banner removed, windows-1252 charset declared.

title: Orange Juice (1997 version)
description: A French-language online magazine about the demoscene: demoparty reports and calendar, what a demo is, groups and handles, artwork and links.
changes: Served as-is from bunny.net; no page was changed.

title: Orange Juice (1998 version)
description: The French-language demoscene magazine, one year on: news in English and French, demoparty reports and calendar, handles and groups, birthdays, demos, interviews and links.
changes: Rebuilt from classic ASP into static HTML: forms, counters and admin pages removed, personal data redacted, font fallbacks added, POST blocked and security headers set at the edge.

title: Orange Juice (1999 version)
description: The French-language demoscene magazine in its database era: news and articles, demoparty calendar, groups and people sheets, interviews, picture library, charts, oneliner and 13 switchable skins.
changes: Rebuilt from classic ASP and SQL Server into static HTML: forms, votes, logins and admin removed, search rewritten client-side, old ASP links redirected, e-mail domains and birth years redacted.

title: Orange Juice v3
description: The demoscene magazine at www.ojuice.net, on its id3 and id3x engines until 2006: news and articles, 25,000 people sheets, groups, parties with results, pictures, oneliner, charts and skins.
changes: Rebuilt from classic ASP, ASP.NET and SQL Server into static HTML by re-rendering the skin templates: forms and logins removed, client-side search, old links redirected, private data redacted.

title: LTP4, before the party
description: Lucky & Tigrou Party 4, the French demoparty of 25-27 August 2000, as its website looked days before: Flash intro and tune, news, forum, how to come, car trips, rules, machines and sponsors.
changes: Recovered from the Wayback Machine (August 2000) and rebuilt into static HTML: forms read-only, counters removed, personal data redacted, Flash intro and mod tune played with Ruffle and libopenmpt.

title: LTP4, after the party
description: Lucky & Tigrou Party 4, the French demoparty of 25-27 August 2000, right after the event: results of every compo, words from organizers and attenders, the financial balance and Skal's fast code compo.
changes: Rebuilt from classic ASP and SSI into static HTML, URLs kept: forum read-only, counters and FTP credentials removed, e-mail domains redacted, 2026 post-scriptum added to the financial balance.

title: LTP5 delayed
description: The home page of the LTP website in 2001: LTP5 delayed, a wall of LTP4 productions and a long tribute to LTP memories written by sceners.
changes: Served as it was, except the dead "LTP party" link, which now opens the LTP4 results, with sans-serif font fallbacks, POST blocked and security headers set at the edge.

title: LTP3, during the party
description: The website that ran during Lucky & Tigrou Party 3, the French demoparty of 1999: news, practical information, planning, network settings, jury, compo entries in order and the vote page.
changes: Rebuilt from static HTML and one ASP page: vote page now a read-only notice with the entry lists, original frameset in a fixed 800x600 iframe, personal data never published, security headers set.

title: LTP3, before the party
description: Lucky & Tigrou Party 3, the French demoparty of 27-29 August 1999, as its website ended: news, information, competitions, final results, financial balance, how to come, registration and Q&A forum.
changes: Rebuilt from classic ASP and SSI into static HTML, original URLs kept: forum read-only, car trips and registrations replaced by a notice, phone and e-mails redacted, security headers set.

title: LTP2, during the party
description: The small website that ran registrations and votes of Lucky & Tigrou Party 2, a French demoparty of 1998: registration form, list of attendees, compo entries and vote results.
changes: Rebuilt from four ASP pages over flat files into static HTML: forms read-only, attendees reduced to handles and groups, results rendered from the files, in an iframe, personal data never published.

title: Scene.org, 2000 home page
description: The home pages of Scene.org, the demoscene file archive and portal, as a copy ran on the id3 engine in autumn 2000: news, services, staff, sponsors, FTP search page and the oneliner.
changes: Rebuilt as static HTML from the id3 skin: forms and FTP search replaced by a notice, Orange Juice oneliner rendered for 2000-09-01 to 2000-11-19 (nicks only), removal contact added.

title: Domage, demogroup pages
description: The pages of Domage, a demogroup ("we are tired of washing") hosted on Scene.org in 2000: news, productions (Bizarre99, Hypnotease, Buena Vista), members and links, in a frameset with a module.
changes: Served as-is from the Scene.org copy, apart from dead links shown as plain text; inner pages reopen inside their frameset when landed on directly; security headers set at the edge.

title: Impact Texture Studio
description: Impact Texture Studio (ITS), a DOS/Windows 9x tool to create tileable 256x256 textures, with its information page and online manual, as hosted on Scene.org in 2000.
changes: Served as-is from the Scene.org copy; the program download (its.exe) is not published, its link is shown as not archived; POST blocked and security headers set at the edge.

title: LTP4, during the party
description: Lucky & Tigroo Party 4, 25-27 August 2000, as seen on the party's own network: news, weekend oneliner, time table, bar prices, network settings, Fast Code rules and the final ranking of every compo.
changes: Re-rendered as static HTML from the id3 skin and its database: upload, vote, login and edit forms removed, entry files not archived, logins, votes and visitor IPs never published, removal contact.

title: Citeweb (1998 redesign)
description: Citeweb, a French free web host run by volunteers from 1996 to 1999: the 1998 framed interface, sign-up and hosting rules, contact page and help pages (FTP, e-mail, newsgroups, IRC, FAQ).
changes: Rebuilt as static HTML from a capture of the redesign: server includes inlined, member area, forums and forms left out, server-bound links turned into text, personal e-mail addresses masked.

title: Citeweb (1997)
description: Citeweb, a French free web host (1996-1999), in its 1997 beta: rules, the CITENEWS member directory, forums page, statistics, and hosted sites (DefCoN ezine, .rIBBON!, Citemag, AUTOMAG).
changes: Rebuilt as static HTML from a Teleport Pro capture of the 1997 server: forms, logins and counters frozen or left out, e-mails and phone numbers masked, member ages and postcodes removed.

title: Nectarine
description: Nectarine, the demoscene web radio at www.scenemusic.net, on the id3 engine until 2006: 18,000+ songs requested and rated by listeners, votes, comments, party rankings, charts, news and oneliner.
changes: Rebuilt from ASP and SQL Server into static HTML, the radio shown off the air as in September 2006: logins, requests and forms removed, client-side search, old links redirected, data redacted.

title: .rIBBON! (1998 version)
description: The website of .rIBBON!, a French demogroup, as of 22 February 1998: productions with screenshots and downloads (Nova, Area, Plume...), history, greetings, contacts, LTP pages, Sid & Chip results.
changes: Served as it was, rebuilt as static HTML with original paths kept: mailing-list form frozen, dead links as text, e-mails masked, demo archives untouched, removal contact on pages showing e-mails.

title: LTP2, before the party
description: The page of Lucky & Tigrou Party 2, the French demoparty of 11-13 April 1998, as the .rIBBON! website showed it weeks before: place and dates, three informintros, entrance fee, details, bus trips.
changes: Served as it was, rebuilt as static HTML with original paths kept: mailing-list form frozen, dead links as text, e-mails masked, demo archives untouched, removal contact on pages showing e-mails.

title: LTP1, after the party
description: What the .rIBBON! website told about Lucky & Tigrou Party, the first edition of the French demoparty: more than 90 entrances, only demomakers, the groups present and the TV report.
changes: Served as it was, rebuilt as static HTML with original paths kept: mailing-list form frozen, dead links as text, e-mails masked, demo archives untouched, removal contact on pages showing e-mails.

title: Chandra (1996)
description: A personal PC and demoscene home page: HotDIR (a DOS directory lister) with its release history and downloads, hardware and software picks, modules, thoughts in French and the decimals of pi.
changes: Frameset replaced by an 800 px wide column of iframes, background MIDI played by a small player, counters removed, e-mail addresses masked except the nick's own; external links in a new tab.
